title: WeatherResult
description: The 'result' payload shape when ProviderResponseEnvelope.capability='weather' (Checkpoint Phase 4 C.0, docs/adr/0009-phase4-checkpointc0-live-data-and-react-design.md). Explicitly distinguishes a forecast, a current observation, historical data, and an unavailable result via 'kind' -- a caller must never infer freshness from field presence alone. freshness/provenance/retrieved_at live on the enclosing ProviderResponseEnvelope, not duplicated here. schema_version 1.1.0 (Checkpoint Phase 4 C.1, docs/adr/0010-phase4-checkpointc1-openmeteo-weather-adapter.md) additively introduces optional 'requested_location', 'country', 'resolved_latitude', 'resolved_longitude', and 'attribution' -- needed once a real geocoding-backed adapter (Open-Meteo) exists to resolve a free-text location and to carry the provider's own attribution/licence notice. Every existing 1.0.0 instance (none of these fields set) remains valid unchanged. schema_version 1.3.0 (Manual QA remediation Q.1, user correction pass §C) additively introduces: 'coverage' (live/historical/mixed -- which of the two data sources below this specific response drew from); 'historical_climate_days' (aggregated prior-year climate guidance for a future trip date beyond Open-Meteo's live forecast horizon, structurally distinct from 'forecast_days' so a caller can never mistake an aggregate for a literal daily forecast); 'years_sampled'/'aggregation_method'/'climate_disclaimer' (full provenance for that aggregate); 'kind' gains one new enum value, 'mixed' (part of the requested range is live, part is historical -- both forecast_days and historical_climate_days are populated, and the full requested range is always covered, never silently truncated); and 'earliest_available_forecast_date' is redefined to be present whenever ANY historical portion is included (kind='historical' or 'mixed'), computed as request.date_from - MAX_FORECAST_DAYS_AHEAD -- a fixed property of the request's own date_from, deliberately never of when the request happens to be evaluated. Every existing 1.2.0 instance (none of these fields/values used) remains valid unchanged.

requested_location.description: 1.1.0+ only. The original, unmodified location string the caller supplied -- preserved even when 'location' below reflects a geocoded/resolved name that differs from it.

country.description: 1.1.0+ only. The resolved country name or code, present only when a geocoding step actually supplied one.

attribution.description: 1.1.0+ only. Present whenever the provider's own terms require attribution -- e.g. Open-Meteo's CC BY 4.0 licence notice. Never fabricated when a provider has no such requirement.

timezone.description: IANA time zone database name (e.g. 'Europe/Istanbul'), never a raw UTC offset -- the offset itself can change with DST. 'UTC' is accepted as the one special-case bare identifier without a '/' (a genuinely valid zoneinfo name, and the honest fallback when no more specific zone could be resolved).

coverage.description: 1.3.0+ only. Which real data source(s) this response actually drew from -- 'live' (Open-Meteo forecast API), 'historical' (Open-Meteo archive API, aggregated across years_sampled), or 'mixed' (both, because the requested range straddled the forecast horizon).

issued_at.description: The provider's own forecast/observation issue time -- distinct from the envelope's retrieved_at (when we fetched it). Absent when kind='unavailable'.

forecast_days.description: Present for kind='forecast' or kind='historical'; empty for 'current_observation'/'unavailable'.

missing_fields.description: Explicitly names any field a caller might expect but this response could not populate -- never silently omitted without a reason recorded here.

earliest_available_forecast_date.description: 1.3.0+ only (Manual QA remediation Q.1, user correction pass §C). Present whenever this response includes any historical portion (kind='historical' or 'mixed') -- the exact date this request's date_from enters Open-Meteo's live forecast horizon, computed as date_from - MAX_FORECAST_DAYS_AHEAD (a fixed property of the request, never of when it happens to be evaluated).

historical_climate_days.description: 1.3.0+ only. Present for kind='historical' or 'mixed'. Deterministic aggregates across years_sampled for each requested future calendar date beyond the live forecast horizon -- structurally distinct from forecast_days (avg_high/avg_low, never high/low) so a caller can never mistake an aggregate for a literal daily forecast.

years_sampled.description: 1.3.0+ only. Present for kind='historical' or 'mixed' -- the fixed, documented set of prior full years aggregated across (see providers/weather_openmeteo.py::CLIMATE_SAMPLE_YEAR_COUNT). Same list as every historical_climate_days[i].years_sampled entry, hoisted to the top level so a caller need not inspect an individual day to learn it.

aggregation_method.description: 1.3.0+ only. Present for kind='historical' or 'mixed' -- names the deterministic aggregation actually used (e.g. 'arithmetic_mean_across_sampled_years'), never left implicit.

climate_disclaimer.description: 1.3.0+ only. Present for kind='historical' or 'mixed' -- a fixed, server-authored disclaimer ('Historical climate guidance -- not a forecast.') that must never be omitted or reworded to imply certainty about a future date.
